title: meridian-outputs canonical run manifest
description: Sprint item 37ce5537. One ledger record (keyed by run_id) persisted by meridian_outputs.run_manifest.start_run_manifest / finalize_run_manifest under <outputs_dir>/.meridian-outputs-cache/run_manifest_ledger.json. See extensions/meridian-outputs/meridian_outputs/run_manifest.py's module docstring for the full composition/reference contract this schema documents. This schema describes the record's SHAPE for documentation and external validation; the Python module is the authoritative implementation.

run_id.description: Caller-supplied unique id for this run. The ledger key.

repo_identity.description: git_state is best-effort local capture (run_manifest.capture_git_state) -- head/dirty_files are None/[] when repo_dir was not given or is not a git repo.

file_hashes.description: path -> sha256 hex digest, or null for a missing/unreadable path (a valid state, never an error).

file_set_hash.description: sha256 over the whole sorted {path: hash} set.

missing_or_unreadable.description: Output paths that could not be re-hashed at finalize time -- fail-closed signal, never silently dropped.

bounds.description: Best-effort snapshot of the indexing bounds actually in effect at start_run_manifest time. Any field may be null if it could not be introspected.

ledger_locations.description: On-disk paths of this ledger plus every sibling ledger this package maintains -- REFERENCES only, never copies of their content.

output_schema_domains.description: Reserved for future raw/dse domain tagging parity with meridian.executor_contract's output_schema; unused by this module today.

external_manifest_hash.description: Optional cross-reference to an externally (e.g. meridian.executor_contract) built execution-manifest hash. Stored verbatim, never re-derived or verified by this module.

artifact_ids.description: artifact_registry public artifact ids validated (via get_artifact) at finalize time -- referenced, never duplicated.

unknown_artifact_ids.description: Caller-declared artifact ids that did NOT resolve in the registry at finalize time -- presence here downgrades an attempted phase="complete" to "partial".

convergence_at_start.description: outputs_local.get_convergence_state() snapshot taken at start_run_manifest time; null if it could not be read.

convergence_at_finish.description: Same shape as convergence_at_start, taken at finalize_run_manifest time; null until finalize runs (or if it could not be read).

manifest_hash.description: sha256 over the deterministic identity fields only (excludes created_at/updated_at/manifest_hash/phase/output_identity/artifact_ids/unknown_artifact_ids/status_reason/convergence_at_start/convergence_at_finish/bounds -- bounds is excluded because its duckdb_memory_limit_bytes field is derived from live available-system-memory at call time, not a stable identity input). Stable across finalize_run_manifest calls; a same-run_id manifest with a different hash is refused.
